goal: Ensure wallet database write and erase failures are handled rather than silently ignored
Prevent wallet corruption and data loss caused by in-memory state desynchronizing from disk
agreement: Support for enforcing database error handling to keep memory and disk states consistent (rkrux)
Concerns about write failures preventing backups or reporting false corruptions were answered (jeanpablojp)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because silent database write failures risk wallet desynchronization, corruption, and data loss.
Halting on write failures prevents running a wallet whose persistent state is compromised.
